reusableLessons: Package runtime exports point at dist; dependent tests must follow build sequentially.
Descriptive handoffs are factual snapshots, not immutable design constraints.
Fresh agents receive one bounded goal and return at its checkpoint; supervisor continues across checkpoints.
Mechanical checks are delegated; supervisor reviews interpretation, ownership, duplicate abstractions and patch-work integration.
